_doc: The ranger Matvei Krechet (Матвей Ильич Кречет; a proposal, docs/north.md People): how blender/characters/rig_character.py turns gen/model.glb (hi3d, not generated yet) into a game character (docs/characters.md). The face fields (face.eye_open, face.marks) are fitted on eye_shots.py close-ups once the model exists; the jacket's hem is a short skirt for the rig (it ends at the hips).
_faces: 15k body + the donor's two hands (~5.7k) + the face rig's eyes/mouth (~4k) = ~25k, the adult budget
